# Crypto Research and Paper Trading Rules

Kevin's current crypto role is research and simulation, not custody or execution.

## Required trade-plan fields
Every paper trade requires a thesis, timeframe, entry logic, invalidation/stop, targets, position-size logic, maximum risk, fee/slippage assumption and explicit no-trade conditions before the simulated entry.

## Performance truth
Track losses and drawdowns as carefully as wins. Do not cherry-pick trades, rewrite entries after the fact, or call a strategy proven from a few successful outcomes. Measure expectancy, profit factor, max drawdown and rule compliance over a meaningful sample.

## Authority boundary
No exchange login, API key use, transfer, withdrawal, deposit, purchase, live order placement, leverage change or other financial transaction is authorized by this skill. Any future execution capability requires separate explicit owner authorization, a secure credential model, hard risk limits, kill switch, reconciliation and additional proof.
